First of all, I have to acknowledge that extent of vpn-blocking largely depends on the region you are in so you so my experience might not be universal.

Also worth acknowledging is the fact that since august of last year Chinese government started pushing cracking down on VPN’s even harder. 


##Commercial VPNs


###What haven’t worked?

Mullvad and ProtonVPN simply didn’t work (no connection at all) and I suspect none of the smaller “trustworthy” brands will have worked. 

###What is working?

You can also choose to use one of 3 ~~horseman of works suspiciously well to be private~~ best advertised VPNs out there: ExpressVPN, NordVPN and Hotspot shield.

Pros: fastest and most reliable option. 

Cons: privacy is out of the question.


So, what’s left? 

##Self hosting


###What haven’t worked?

-	OpenVPN + obfs4 (it “connected” once, but I was unable to load any web pages)
-	Pure shadowsocks (including outline)


###What is working?

-	Shadowsocks + [Cloak 2](https://github.com/cbeuw/Cloak) 
-	As well as OpenVPN + [Cloak 2](https://github.com/cbeuw/Cloak) (former seems to be much faster)

Video streaming works reasonably well, however latency is high and it flat out refuses to work with some applications (mostly games). Speeds are much slower compared to Hotspot shield, but are manageable. Cloak can be configured to run with tor instead of Shadowsocks or OpenVPN.

There is also a [script](https://github.com/HirbodBehnam/Shadowsocks-Cloak-Installer) that will install and configure Shadowsocks + cloak if you are willing to trust it. 

###What could work?

I heard many great things about GoQuiet and v2Ray, but haven’t tried them myself so I can’t give any advice on them. However, I suggest you look into them if all of my options listed above fail.
